mentions.name: Self-hosted recipe app
mentions.description: This is a recipe app built to run independently of AWS or Cloudflare, so users can still access their recipes even when major cloud services go down. Launch is planned in 2026.
mentions.problem: Recipe apps that depend on cloud providers like AWS or Cloudflare become inaccessible when those services go down.
mentions.source_excerpt: A recipe app that is not dependent on AWS or Cloudflare. When everything else goes down, at least you can cook :)

evidence.value: A recipe app that is not dependent on AWS or Cloudflare. When everything else goes down, at least you can cook :)
